meta.name: standup
meta.description: Facilitate a read-only standup across git worktrees, branches, or PRs to compare changes and produce one consolidation plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 汇总多个分支或PR的变更，生成统一计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个工作分支间快速同步变更并制定合并计划
copy.tagline_en: Aggregate changes across branches or PRs into one consolidation plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly sync changes across multiple work branches and create a merge plan

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把每个 git worktree(以及你挑的 PR)当成一个独立的代理人,拉进同一个 markdown 房间分轮对话,比较各自的改动,最后写出一份合并计划:哪个是目标、按什么顺序合并、冲突怎么解。全程只读,不提交、不合并。
howto.when: 当你想把多个 worktree、分支或 PR 的改动汇总成一份合并计划,或提到 standup 时触发。候选只有 0 或 1 个时不算 standup,会提议扩大范围然后停下。

say.text: 给最近 4 小时活跃的 worktree 开个 standup
say.note: Claude 先列名单让你确认

say.text: 把这些分支和这个 PR 放进同一个房间,给我合并顺序
say.note: 只读讨论,计划随后交给 /do

say.text: 用大白话讲每个分支改了什么、哪些要我拍板

howto.what_en: Claude treats each git worktree (and any PRs you pick) as an agent in one shared markdown room, runs rounds, then writes one consolidation plan: target worktree, merge order, conflicts. Read-only — no commits or merges.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want scattered worktrees, branches or PRs reconciled into one merge plan, or when you mention a standup. With zero or one candidate it says so, offers to widen, and stops.

say_en.text: Run a standup on the worktrees active in the last 4 hours
say_en.note: Claude lists the roster and confirms it first

say_en.text: Put these branches and this PR in one room and give me a merge order
say_en.note: Read-only discussion; the plan goes to /do after

say_en.text: Explain in plain language what each branch changed and what I must decide
